item.content:encoded:
Voted Best Golf Course in the state

Dogwood Golf Links

BOOK NOW

Welcome to Dogwood Links!

A True Links Experience

The Links golf course is a unique experience for golfers of all levels. This style of golf is characterized by rolling greens, strategically placed bunkers, and the occasional sandy beach. Dogwood Links encourages a strategic approach to the game, with each hole requiring careful consideration of the wind conditions and club selection. Our links style of golf provides a challenge for experienced golfers, while also providing a great opportunity for beginners to learn the basics of the game. The Links course also offers stunning views of the surrounding landscape, making every round of golf a unique and memorable experience.

EVENTS

TEE TIMES

MEMBERSHIP

e-CLUB

Links Style Golf at Its Best

Voted top Links Course in The State

The design of the course itself is a tribute to the traditional links-style course architecture, with wide fairways, firm turf, and a variety of challenging bunkers and bunkering complexes. The course features a mixture of long, par-4s, short par-3s, and par-5s, making it a great test for players of all skill levels.

item.title: Course Information
item.dc:creator: gnbhash
item.content:encoded:
Learn About This Course

Welcome to Dogwood Golf Links! We are proud to offer a unique golfing experience for players of all ages and skill levels. Our Par 72, 18-hole championship course is designed to challenge even the most experienced golfer while providing an enjoyable and rewarding experience for beginners. Our course is surrounded by beautiful scenery, tranquil lakes, and lush greenery, making it an ideal spot for a day of golfing. Whether a beginner or an experienced golfer, we guarantee you'll have a great time at Dogwood Golf Links.

Practice Facility

The Golf Practice Facility at the Dogwood Golf Links is a great place to improve your golf game! This fantastic facility features two tiers of grass tee boxes, an expansive practice green, two practice bunkers, and two separate driving ranges with targets. The facility also offers a chipping green and short game area, perfect for honing your short game skills. The entire facility has been designed to provide golfers with the best possible training environment. We also offer golf lessons to help you take your game to the next level. So whether you're looking to get some practice in or take a lesson, the Golf Practice Facility at Dogwood Golf Links is the perfect place to perfect your game.

item.title: Membership
item.dc:creator: gnbhash
item.content:encoded:
Tee up with our exclusive membership options!

Becoming a member of a Dogwood Golf Links is a great way to get out and enjoy the fresh air, challenge yourself with a new sport, and meet new people. As a golf course member, you’ll have access to all the amenities, including lessons with golf professionals, discounts on green fees, and exclusive events. Plus, you’ll be rewarded with the satisfaction of spending more time doing what you love and spending time with friends, family, or coworkers in a fun and competitive atmosphere.

Request Membership Information

Hole in One Member

$10,000/yr
  • Most exclusive of the memberships. Greens and carts fees included. 1-month advanced tee times. Priority entry to all tournaments included. 30% discount in the pro shop. 10 free lessons.

Birdie Member

$6,000/yr
  • Birdie members receive free greens fees and discounted cart fees. 2-week advanced tee times. 15% discount to the pro shop.

Eagle Member

$8,000/yr
  • This second-tier membership offers a variety of excellent benefits. Greens and cart fees included. 2-week advanced tee times. 20% discount to the pro shop.

Benefits of Membership

  • Putting and Chipping Greens
  • Stocked Golf Shop
  • 10% Discount on Golf Shop Merchandise
  • Banquet and Meeting Facilities
  • Large Driving Range
  • Golf lessons from our PGA Golf Professional
  • Cart and Range Fee included
  • Family-friendly Member events

item.dc:creator: gnbhash
item.content:encoded:
We'd love to help you host an outing or event at Dogwood Links! We offer a variety of services to make your event a success, including catering, decorations, and entertainment. Please contact us to discuss your needs and we'll work together to create a special event that meets your expectations. We look forward to making your outing/event one to remember!

Event Spaces

Corporate Events

Rent out the clubhouse to host your next corporate event.

Meeting Rooms

We offer four options of meeting rooms to rent for your event. Rooms vary to hold parties of 10 people up to 200 people.

Golf Outings

Hosting a golf tournament, event, or outing? We have the perfect place for you!

Your Luxury Wedding Starts at Mulberry Golf Club

Just outside downtown, Dogwood is the perfect wedding destination!

Dogwood Golf Links is a stunning venue for your special day! Located just outside of downtown, this venue offers the perfect backdrop for your dream wedding. With a romantic garden and breathtaking views, you and your guests will be in awe of the beauty of this venue. The staff at is dedicated to ensuring that your special day is perfect and will work with you to make all of your dreams come true. Whether you are looking for an intimate gathering or a large celebration, Dogwood Golf Links can accommodate your needs.

Our Wedding Spaces

Event Hall

Our event hall is the perfect wedding venue for your special day. With a spacious interior, natural lighting, and a charming atmosphere, your guests will be delighted with the ambiance.

Outdoor Location

Our iconic Grand Lawn offers a breathtaking panoramic view of the championship golf course and lakes, providing the perfect setting for a ceremony. Highly sought after for both wedding ceremonies and receptions, our Grand Lawn exudes romance. Dance the night away under the stars with towering ivy, twinkling lights, and unique architecture all around you. Contact us today to take a tour.

Patio

Our beautiful patio has plenty of room for seating, a dance floor, and plenty of space to mingle with your family and friends. With stunning views, breathtaking sunsets, and plenty of amenities, our patio wedding venue is sure to provide the perfect backdrop for your special day.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: mburgoon
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Voted Best Golf Course in the state

Dogwood Golf Links

BOOK NOW

Welcome to Dogwood Links!

A True Links Experience

The Links golf course is a unique experience for golfers of all levels. This style of golf is characterized by rolling greens, strategically placed bunkers, and the occasional sandy beach. Dogwood Links encourages a strategic approach to the game, with each hole requiring careful consideration of the wind conditions and club selection. Our links style of golf provides a challenge for experienced golfers, while also providing a great opportunity for beginners to learn the basics of the game. The Links course also offers stunning views of the surrounding landscape, making every round of golf a unique and memorable experience.

EVENTS

TEE TIMES

MEMBERSHIP

e-CLUB

Links Style Golf at Its Best

Voted top Links Course in The State

The design of the course itself is a tribute to the traditional links-style course architecture, with wide fairways, firm turf, and a variety of challenging bunkers and bunkering complexes. The course features a mixture of long, par-4s, short par-3s, and par-5s, making it a great test for players of all skill levels.

The restaurant at our golf course is the perfect place to relax after a round. Enjoy a delicious menu of classic American and international cuisine, plus an extensive selection of wine and beer.
